approved_correction.text: Correction for INC-4821: restoration at 21:30 CDT on September 7 applies only to North America Central. EMEA and APAC recovery is still in progress. Further updates will remain in this incident thread.

distribution_routing.standalone_posts: The Regional Status Relay creates a new bulletin card and distributes it independently to subscriber portals.
distribution_routing.incident_replies: The Regional Status Relay attaches a reply to the parent incident bulletin's update history.
